cohort: 21,107 women pregnant with twins with the first twin in cephalic position, who delivered between 32+0 - 41+0 weeks between 2000 and 2012 in the Netherlands
finding: Planned vaginal delivery resulted in comparable neonatal outcomes to planned caesarean delivery for twin pregnancies with the first twin in cephalic position, even with a low intrapartum caesarean delivery rate of 19.7%.
mod_finding: At term, planned caesarean delivery may result in less asphyxia- and trauma-related outcomes.
